results.readme_quote: A false claim blocks the agent from finishing until the code makes it true.
results.reason: Needs a Claude Code agent session and Stop hook, not a web page.

results.readme_quote: `rld gate` is the cheap loop for the Stop hook.
results.reason: CLI behaviour (ordering, stop at first failure, skipping) is not visible in a browser.

results.readme_quote: `rld gate` exits 0 when every claim is true, 1 when a claim is false or stale, 3 when the result is inconclusive, and 4 when the tool itself or Kane failed.
results.reason: Process exit codes are not observable in a browser.

results.readme_quote: Python 3.11 or newer and Node.js (tested with v24.22.1).
Install the pinned Kane CLI: `npm install -g @testmuai/kane-cli@0.10.4`
